checks.label: Problem, scope, expected behavior and success criterion documented
Existing relevant behavior and repository baseline observed
Constraints, data flow and uncertainties recorded
Alternatives, tradeoffs and smallest viable change compared
Sensitive assets, trust boundaries and threat exposure identified
Design and testable acceptance criteria approved for implementation
Contracts, state, invariants and compatibility captured
Verification matrix with failure and boundary scenarios
Rollout, reversibility, rollback and operational impacts planned
Threat controls, privacy and least privilege reviewed
Authorized human approval recorded for critical high-impact work
Change matches intended scope and respects existing work
Relevant checks executed and actual results recorded
Negative, permission and regression tests exercised
Security/peer review outcomes and remaining issues recorded
Observability, performance and failure mode evidence captured
Delivery report, unresolved risks and skipped checks disclosed
Pre-release requirements and change authorization confirmed
Rollback, monitoring, ownership and stop conditions verified
Actual release state and post-release evidence reported
